$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-02 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report 633d610f. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v29 index for sub2api (INDEX f8e017cf) built by publish-tee-images run 33597943550 from commit edf4e17ae; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin (INDEX cef1d03d) because deploy/attestor was not touched, and repinning it would widen the attested surface for nothing. VERIFICATION SCOPE, stated plainly: composeHash, osImageHash, the image digests and the build commit were each read back from a live source, and composeHash was cross-checked against two independent ones. The cosign keyless signature was NOT verified locally for this release - the workflow performs the signing and its run succeeded, and anyone can verify certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market plus the embedded githubWorkflowSha against the sourceCommit below, but this file does not claim it was done. Copy only: no backend code, no migrations. It closes the item left outstanding in proof-v28. Three referral messages, which a user copies and sends to other people, still quoted half the official API price - the figure from before August 2026, when the multiplier moved to 14 percent. The landing page, the documentation site and the GitBook were all updated at the time and these were missed, so every share quoted a price the platform does not charge. They were easy to miss precisely because nobody reads them in place: they live behind a disclosure on the referral page and are only ever seen after being copied out. The price line now reads 14 percent, and the model version in all three moved to Fable 5.1 at the same time. A test was added that pins the numbers rather than the wording: the current figure must appear, the invite-link placeholder must survive, the comparison must be against the official API, the model version must not sit on a Fable 5 without the point one, and no historical pricing phrasing may reappear. That last list is append-only - keeping the dead figures in it is what stops one of them being copied back in from an old branch or an old document. The next pricing change will turn this test red, which is the point of it. Earlier in this line: proof-v28 (two audience-specific films placed beside the sections they describe, provider film following the interface language, Fable 5.1 copy), v27 (footer contact rail, X account), v26 (upstream sync through v0.1.185 and beyond, Claude Fable 5.1), v24 (pricing copy at 14 percent and a 50 percent revenue share), v23, v22, v21, v20, v19, v18, v17, v16/v15. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation, and the control plane confirms is_dev false after the rollout. A full postgres backup was taken and verified beforehand - downloaded from S3, gzip-tested, 110 COPY sections. Frontend suite: 275 files and 2016 cases, type check and lint clean. This rollout completed in 92 seconds with no incident.
